status: PROPOSED (calibration step 4); adoption as optimizer defaults is the user's decision

tool_factor.source: Sandvik CoroPlus ToolGuide cutting-data screens, CoroMill Dura 1K344-0200-XC 1730 (2 mm, 4 FL), 17-4 PH at 200 and 345 HB and 45 NCD 16 at 420 HB (user screenshots 2026-10-15); docs/research/sandvik_toolguide_probes.md; geometric mean of 3 pre-machining readings, log sd 0.001

k_r.source: Kr/Kt 0.34–0.38 for carbide end mills in 45 steel (Sun, Ding, Deng, Xiong 2023, Sensors 23:8954, Table 2); Krc/Ktc 0.50 for Ti6Al4V (Li, Zhao, Li, He 2014, J. Vibroeng. 16:2657, citing Altintas, Manufacturing Automation 2nd ed.); no stainless value found; 0.4 kept (inside 0.34–0.50)

k_te_n_mm.source: Edge coefficients 12–43 N/mm (Ti6Al4V Kte 24 / Kfe 43, Altintas MAL review Table 1; 16MnCr5 28.8 N/mm, Popović et al. 2017 FME Trans. 45:4 Table 1; 1020 steel 12.25 N/mm, Salehi et al. 2018 Procedia CIRP). Sandvik's kc1 is fitted to total force, so adding them double-counts; the ToolGuide probes all sit at one h_m (4.9 µm), so they cannot separate an edge term

k_re_n_mm.source: Edge coefficients 12–43 N/mm (Ti6Al4V Kte 24 / Kfe 43, Altintas MAL review Table 1; 16MnCr5 28.8 N/mm, Popović et al. 2017 FME Trans. 45:4 Table 1; 1020 steel 12.25 N/mm, Salehi et al. 2018 Procedia CIRP). Sandvik's kc1 is fitted to total force, so adding them double-counts; the ToolGuide probes all sit at one h_m (4.9 µm), so they cannot separate an edge term

speed.source: folded into each family's vc_ref_sfm (vc_ref_sfm_median is the level before it): smallest grid value (1.000–2.000 by 0.025) bringing every band's median realized bias on the training rows to ≥ the target, with C14 capping at 1.00 × the training-bucket vendor median

c2.source: Material.c2_scale on the chip_limits.json band median: smallest grid value (1.000–2.000 by 0.025) bringing every band's median realized bias on the training rows to ≥ the target, with C14 capping at 1.00 × the training-bucket vendor median

consensus_offsets.why: at 75 % C14 caps at 1.00 × the vendor median, so the output is min(physics, median); the physics side sits a little above the median so that the 75 % output lands on it (user 2026-10-17)

m.source: EMPIRICAL; least absolute deviations over training rows against their bucket vendor medians; D_knee by grid (smallest worst per-band bias)

knee_in.source: least absolute deviations over training rows against their bucket vendor medians; D_knee by grid (smallest worst per-band bias)

speed_diameter.why_empirical: within a chart vendors print one SFM for all diameters; the trend is between tool series. No cited physical law was found (lookup: no vc ∝ D^m in the literature; micro tools are 'starved for spindle rpm', MSC/Iscar, second-hand)

k.source: within-chart contrasts, 1271 rows in 516 charts, equal vendor weights

ae_min.source: grid search on the within-chart residual

AlTiN/TiAlN.source: not applied: the speed level is fitted to bucket vendor medians, which mix coatings; fitted within-vendor factor reported (reference class)

AlCrN.source: not applied: the speed level is fitted to bucket vendor medians, which mix coatings; fitted within-vendor factor reported (applied: ≥ 2 vendor groups, ≥ 2 families and |t| ≥ 2; confounded with tool series (within-vendor contrasts))

Si-doped.source: not applied: the speed level is fitted to bucket vendor medians, which mix coatings; fitted within-vendor factor reported (applied: ≥ 2 vendor groups, ≥ 2 families and |t| ≥ 2; confounded with tool series (within-vendor contrasts))
